In a daze, she watched his hand as he moved the quill so rapidly and with such quick little scratches over the parchment. Tristan had such large and beautiful hands. His soft curling golden hair was mussed and loose and half veiled his face. She longed to be able to touch it, lift it, move it back away from his eyes, but she had never been permitted to do such a thing, and she might never, she knew. As she obeyed, glancing up furtively for a split second, he turned and smiled at her and it was as if a great bright light had washed over her warming her to her soul.
